name: Kutsubisei no Diavolos
original_name: 屈日性のディアヴォロス
source:
This is the story of the protagonist being fallen in love with by a strange lifeform wearing a manure bag.

Aoi-kun, the ill-natured protagonist, is an honor student playing at being a good person. Though he's a delinquent, the childish, friendly Koyashi-kun likes him. This is an eroge where one thing after another happens and they become lovers.
